pages.text: The controller has two tanks of $(item)8000 mB$() each, shared by the whole square. Each tick the oven cooks it adds:$(br2)$(li)coal: $(item)1 mB creosote$() and $(item)30 mB CO2$()$(li)logs: $(item)2 mB creosote$() and $(item)20 mB CO2$()

$(l)Where to pump$()$(li)$(item)Creosote$() comes out of $(item)any side$() and the bottom.$(li)$(item)CO2$() comes out of the $(item)top face only$(). Put a pump on top of the oven.$(br2)Both tanks are $(item)drain only$(): you cannot pipe anything in, so a stray water line cannot clog them.

CO2 builds up fast: at 30 mB per tick the CO2 tank fills in under 15 seconds of cooking. Pipe it from the top to an $(item)exhaust$() or a $(item)smokestack$() to get rid of it (see the Hot Air chapter).$(br2)Keep the creosote: it is one of the two fuels of the $(item)blast stove$(), which heats air for the blast furnace.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
